rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site ENIGMA CHR-P consortium; 29 international sites
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: “The ENIGMA CHR-P consortium applied a harmonised analysis to neuroimaging data across 29 international sites, including 1579 CHR-P individuals and 1243 HC, offering the largest pooled CHR-P neuroimaging dataset to date.”

rci2_using_epd.detail: ENIGMA CHR-P dataset used for the reference cohort
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: “The ENIGMA CHR-P dataset amalgamated clinical and neuroimaging data from 29 sites, comprising 1579 individuals meeting CHR-P criteria ... and 1243 HC participants.”
